name = "imbalancedChen"
version = "0.1.0"
defaultTargets = ["ImbalancedChen"]
moreLeanArgs = ["-DmaxRecDepth=100000", "-DmaxHeartbeats=4000000"]

[[require]]
name = "mathlib"
git = "https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4.git"
rev = "e4c91783ca8e6a7c693ae624ade32fd22d4e43c1"

[[require]]
name = "goldbach"
git = "https://github.com/subfish-zhou/goldbach-lean.git"
rev = "09b97db5764ade1246bfb77206baa1b124760958"

[[lean_lib]]
name = "ImbalancedChen"

[[lean_lib]]
name = "Mathlib.Data.Matrix.Notation"

[[lean_lib]]
name = "Mathlib.Tactic.Omega"

[[lean_lib]]
name = "SecondFunctionalUnitKernelOscillation"

[[lean_lib]]
name = "SecondFunctionalUnitKernelRegularity"

[[lean_lib]]
name = "SecondFunctionalUnitKernelVariation"

[[lean_lib]]
name = "SecondFunctionalUnitPrimeFibreCap"

[[lean_lib]]
name = "SecondFunctionalUnitPrimeFibreFinite"

[[lean_lib]]
name = "SecondFunctionalUnitPrimeFibreReweight"

[[lean_lib]]
name = "SecondFunctionalUnitPrimeFibreScalar"

[[lean_lib]]
name = "U8CarrierCompatible"

[[lean_lib]]
name = "U8Core"

[[lean_lib]]
name = "U8Geometry"

[[lean_lib]]
name = "U8OptimalCRTJoint"

[[lean_lib]]
name = "U8OptimalPrefix"

[[lean_lib]]
name = "U8PairGeometry"

[[lean_lib]]
name = "U8PhysicalCompatible"

[[lean_lib]]
name = "U8SmallPrefixFibres"

[[lean_lib]]
name = "U8SmallPrefixLocalRoots"

[[lean_lib]]
name = "U8SmallPrefixTwoLinear"

[[lean_lib]]
name = "U8SquarefreeHarmonicLower"

[[lean_lib]]
name = "U8TruncatedSelberg"

[[lean_lib]]
name = "U8TwoDimensionalConvolution"

[[lean_lib]]
name = "U8TwoDimensionalDensity"

[[lean_lib]]
name = "U8TwoDimensionalMain"

[[lean_lib]]
name = "U8TwoLinearCRT"

name = "U8TwoLinearInterval"

name = "U8TwoLinearRemainder"
